points.description: States that usable life is a period of time (the duration/time span up to which the reservoir remains in service).
States that this period extends beyond the useful/economic life of the reservoir (i.e., it begins after/continues past the useful or economic life).
points.partial_credit: Mentions useful or economic life but does not clearly say the period extends beyond it: no part marks unless the relationship is clearly stated.

points.description: States that during this period the reservoir can continue to serve only some (not all) of its purposes, up to the end of that period.
points.partial_credit: Says it continues to serve its purposes but omits 'some/partial': no marks.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three elements: a period of time, extending beyond the useful/economic life, and the reservoir still serving some of its purposes. A vague definition such as 'the life of the reservoir' or 'time until it silts up' earns nothing. Confusing usable life with useful/economic life, or saying it serves all purposes, loses that point.
